_comment: red-pill settings fragment for Claude Code. Merged (not overwritten) into settings.json by scripts/inject_settings.py. Grants the agent access to its transversal dirs OUTSIDE the workspace. NO defaultMode here on purpose: autonomous bypass is a per-launch CLI flag, never a shared-session default.
_comment_hooks: Stop hook = RAW CAPTURE LAYER for Claude Code, symmetric to the opencode scribe plugin. Deterministically queues each turn's prompt+response into memory_queue, so capture no longer depends on the agent invoking the handshake relay. UserPromptSubmit + Stop also mark the session liveness heartbeat (RFC-DESPERTAR-001 P4: empty .start/.end files under ${STATE_DIR}/sessions/live/, mtime = signal); StopFailure (API error, fires instead of Stop) and SessionEnd close the turn (.end) via redpill_turn_start.py. An Esc interrupt fires no hook (TTL SESSION_ACTIVE_MIN covers it). Scripts deployed to ~/.claude/hooks/ by inject_settings.py from seeds/settings/hooks/.
